section_title: Concluding an investigation and suspicious activity reporting > Defensive suspicious activity reports

cards.title: Avoiding Defensive SARs: Best Practice Assessment
cards.summary: When an organization lacks sufficient time or understanding for proper monitoring and research, it should consider its risk appetite and customer relationship rather than filing a defensive SAR, which signals compliance deficiencies and burdens law enforcement.

flow_nodes.label: Lack of sufficient time or complete understanding of business model to properly monitor/research customer activity
Consider business risk appetite and customer relationship
Defensive SARs are a sign of weakness or deficiencies in AFC compliance program
Defensive SARs unduly burden law enforcement, impede ability to quickly act on genuine suspicious activity, and hinder organization's ability to identify/report suspicious activity
Avoid filing defensive SAR; instead address underlying compliance program deficiencies

cards.review_notes: Card captures the best practice assessment for avoiding defensive SARs. Evidence is explicit, with clear trigger (v7u_N003610), action (v7u_N003610), standards (v7u_N003609, v7u_N003606), and output (v7u_N003611). No strict process order reconstruction needed.
